source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 22.2.5 (PDF 195-196) with the worked example.

blocks.text: Range data ke phailao (spread ya dispersion) ka aik paimana hai. Yeh variability (farq) naapne ka sab se saada tareeqa hai aur batata hai ke data mein farq kitna hai. Range data ki sab se bari (maximum) aur sab se chhoti (minimum) qeemat ka farq hai. Bari range ka matlab hai ke data zyada phaila hua hai, yani qeematein aik doosre se door hain; chhoti range ka matlab hai ke qeematein kisi beech wali qeemat ke qareeb ghani jama hain.

items: Xₘₐₓ = data ki sab se bari qeemat.
Xₘᵢₙ = data ki sab se chhoti qeemat.

blocks.title: Range nikalne ke qadam (misaal)
blocks.problem: Kuch logon ki umrein (saal): 25, 20, 22, 30, 42, 45, 50. Range kya hai?
steps: Qadam 4: maximum mein se minimum manfi karein: Range = Xₘₐₓ − Xₘᵢₙ.

blocks.text: Kitab ke qadam 4 mein likha hai 'maximum ko minimum mein se manfi karein'. Yeh ulta hai: minimum ko maximum mein se manfi karte hain (Xₘₐₓ − Xₘᵢₙ), warna jawab minus mein (20 − 50 = −30) aa jaye. Kitab ka formula aur hisaab (50 − 20 = 30) sahih hain.
blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti

blocks.prompt: Range kabhi kabhi data ka phailao ghalat kyun dikha sakti hai?
blocks.explanation: Range sirf do intehai qeematein (sab se bari aur sab se chhoti) istemal karti hai. Agar aik qeemat ghair maamooli (baqi sab se bohat door) ho to range bohat bari ho jati hai, chahe baqi data aik doosre ke qareeb ho.

items: Range = Xₘₐₓ − Xₘᵢₙ; phailao ka sab se saada paimana.
